claims.text: The generalization ability of NCEL is verified by evaluating its performance on five different benchmarks, demonstrating consistent outperformance compared to baselines.
NCEL shows good generalization ability, particularly in challenging datasets, indicating robustness against noise and data sparsity.
The model's performance across diverse datasets indicates its ability to generalize well beyond the training data, as evidenced by consistent results.
